steps.en: Build the CLI from a release-tagged checkout
steps.zh: 在 release-tag 检出上构建 CLI

steps.en: Compress a payload with a pre-built format profile
steps.zh: 用预置格式 profile 压一个数据文件

steps.en: Splits records into homogeneous streams and composes codec primitives into a graph
steps.zh: 把记录拆成同质流，把 codec 原语编排成压缩图

steps.en: Train a compressor specialized for your dataset
steps.zh: 在自己的数据集上训练专用压缩器

steps.en: Searches and benchmarks candidate codec graphs, keeping the best for your data
steps.zh: 搜索并基准测试候选 codec 图，留下最适合的

steps.en: Decompress any frame with the one universal decompressor
steps.zh: 用同一个通用解压器解压任意帧

steps.en: Reads every frame no matter which specialized compressor produced it
steps.zh: 无论由哪个专用压缩器生成，都能读取该帧

value.en: Structured data compressed past generic-compressor ratios, while one decompressor still reads every frame
value.zh: 结构化数据压出超过通用压缩器的比率，一个解压器仍通读所有帧

sources: docs quickstart https://facebook.github.io/openzl/getting-started/quick-start (retrieved 2026-09-28): git clone --depth 1 -b release https://github.com/facebook/openzl.git; cmake -S . -B cmakebuild; cmake --build cmakebuild --target zli; ./zli compress --profile le-u64 sra0 --output sra0.zl; ./zli train --profile le-u64 sra0 --output sra0.zlc; ./zli decompress sra0.zl --output sra0.decompressed

README.md dev @ 2026-09-28: core library and tools to generate specialized compressors, all compatible with a single universal decompressor; release-tagged frames remain decompressible for years, dev branch offers no guarantees
